The present bail application has been filed under Section 439 Cr.P.C.

The petitioner has been arrested in connection with FIR No.249/2022, Police Station Sardarpura, Distt.
Jodhpur City West for the offence under Sections 420, 406, 120-B of IPC and Section 5/6, 496 of Chit Fund Act.

sentences.text: Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that the offences alleged to have been committed by the petitioner is triable by Magistrate.
It is further submitted that now, a compromise has been arrived at between the parties.
The petitioner is in judicial custody and the trial of the case will take sufficient long time.
Therefore, the benefit of bail may be granted to the accused- petitioner.
Learned Public Prosecutor has opposed the bail application.
[2023:RJ-JD:30445] (2 of 2) [CRLMB-11873/2023] Learned counsel for the complainant has concurred the fact of compromise.

I have considered the arguments advanced before me and gone through the material available on record.

sentences.text: Taking into account the facts and circumstances of the case, without commenting on the merits of the case, this Court deems it just and proper to release the petitioner on bail.

Accordingly, the bail application under Section 439 Cr.P.C. is allowed and it is ordered that the accused-petitioner Sunny Madhogadiya S/o Shri Ramesh Kumar shall be enlarged on bail in FIR No.249/2022, Police Station Sardarpura, Distt. Jodhpur City West provided he furnishes a personal bond in the sum of Rs.1,00,000/- with two sureties of Rs.50,000/- each to the satisfaction of the learned trial Judge for his appearance before the court concerned on all the dates of hearing as and when called upon to do so.
